import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left (left child red AND left.left child red)
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def node_size : Node → Nat
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r => node_size l + node_size r + 1

def left_child : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l

def right_child : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => r

def neg_color : Color → Color
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red

def set_black : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => Node.Tree Color.Black v l r

def contains : Node → Int → Bool
  | Node.Empty, _ => false
  | Node.Tree _ w l r, v =>
    if v = w then true else if v < w then contains l v else contains r v

def min_val : Node → Int
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ v Node.Empty _ => v
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => min_val l

def rotate_left : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree _ rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr
  | t => t

def rotate_right : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r =>
      Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  | t => t

def flip_colors : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree lc lv ll lr) (Node.Tree rc rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree (neg_color c) v
        (Node.Tree (neg_color lc) lv ll lr)
        (Node.Tree (neg_color rc) rv rl rr)
  | t => t

/-- Rotate the right child of `t` to the right (`h.right := rotateRight h.right`). -/
def rotate_right_right : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v l r => Node.Tree c v l (rotate_right r)
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty

/-- `h` is red, `h.left` and `h.left.left` are black: make `h.left` or one of
its children red. -/
def move_red_left (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (left_child (right_child (flip_colors t))) then
    flip_colors (rotate_left (rotate_right_right (flip_colors t)))
  else flip_colors t

/-- `h` is red, `h.right` and `h.right.left` are black: make `h.right` or one of
its children red. -/
def move_red_right (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (left_child (left_child (flip_colors t))) then
    flip_colors (rotate_right (flip_colors t))
  else flip_colors t

/-- Restore the LLRBT colour invariants at `t` on the way back up, in the three
standard steps: kill a right-leaning red, split a double left red, and push up a
red pair.  Each step is the identity on `Node.Empty`. -/
def fixup1 (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (right_child t) && !is_red (left_child t) then rotate_left t else t

def fixup2 (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (left_child t) && is_red (left_child (left_child t)) then rotate_right t else t

def fixup3 (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (left_child t) && is_red (right_child t) then flip_colors t else t

def fixup (t : Node) : Node := fixup3 (fixup2 (fixup1 t))

/-- Delete the minimum key; `n` is a fuel bound (`node_size t` suffices). -/
def delete_min : Nat → Node → Node
  | 0, t => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | n + 1, Node.Tree c w l r =>
    match l with
    | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
    | _ =>
      let t := if !is_red l && !is_red (left_child l) then
                 move_red_left (Node.Tree c w l r)
               else Node.Tree c w l r
      match t with
      | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
      | Node.Tree c' w' l' r' => fixup (Node.Tree c' w' (delete_min n l') r')

/-- Recursive descent deletion of `v`; `n` is a fuel bound. -/
def delete_core : Nat → Node → Int → Node
  | 0, t, _ => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty, _ => Node.Empty
  | n + 1, Node.Tree c w l r, v =>
    if v < w then
      let t := if !is_red l && !is_red (left_child l) then
                 move_red_left (Node.Tree c w l r)
               else Node.Tree c w l r
      match t with
      | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
      | Node.Tree c' w' l' r' => fixup (Node.Tree c' w' (delete_core n l' v) r')
    else
      let t1 := if is_red l then rotate_right (Node.Tree c w l r)
                else Node.Tree c w l r
      match t1 with
      | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
      | Node.Tree c1 w1 l1 r1 =>
        match r1 with
        | Node.Empty => if v = w1 then Node.Empty else t1
        | _ =>
          let t2 := if !is_red r1 && !is_red (left_child r1) then
                      move_red_right (Node.Tree c1 w1 l1 r1)
                    else Node.Tree c1 w1 l1 r1
          match t2 with
          | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
          | Node.Tree c2 w2 l2 r2 =>
            if v = w2 then
              fixup (Node.Tree c2 (min_val r2) l2 (delete_min n r2))
            else
              fixup (Node.Tree c2 w2 l2 (delete_core n r2 v))

/-- Top-level deletion: colour the root red for the descent (when both of its
children are black), run the descent, then recolour the root black. -/
def delete_top (t : Node) (v : Int) : Node :=
  if !contains t v then t
  else
    let t0 := match t with
      | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
      | Node.Tree _ w l r =>
          if !is_red l && !is_red r then Node.Tree Color.Red w l r
          else Node.Tree Color.Black w l r
    set_black (delete_core (node_size t + 1) t0 v)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  delete_top t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem view_node (c : Color) (v : Int) (l r : Node) :
    view (Node.Tree c v l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {v} := rfl

theorem view_rotate_left (t : Node) : view (rotate_left t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r =>
    cases r with
    | Empty => rfl
    | Tree rc rv rl rr =>
      simp only [rotate_left, view_node]
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto

theorem view_rotate_right (t : Node) : view (rotate_right t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => rfl
    | Tree lc lv ll lr =>
      simp only [rotate_right, view_node]
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto

theorem view_flip_colors (t : Node) : view (flip_colors t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => rfl
    | Tree lc lv ll lr =>
      cases r with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree rc rv rl rr => rfl

theorem view_rotate_right_right (t : Node) : view (rotate_right_right t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r => simp only [rotate_right_right, view_node, view_rotate_right]

theorem view_move_red_left (t : Node) : view (move_red_left t) = view t := by
  unfold move_red_left
  split_ifs
  · rw [view_flip_colors, view_rotate_left, view_rotate_right_right, view_flip_colors]
  · exact view_flip_colors t

theorem view_move_red_right (t : Node) : view (move_red_right t) = view t := by
  unfold move_red_right
  split_ifs
  · rw [view_flip_colors, view_rotate_right, view_flip_colors]
  · exact view_flip_colors t

theorem view_fixup (t : Node) : view (fixup t) = view t := by
  unfold fixup fixup1 fixup2 fixup3
  split_ifs <;>
    simp only [view_rotate_left, view_rotate_right, view_flip_colors]

theorem size_rotate_left (t : Node) : node_size (rotate_left t) = node_size t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r =>
    cases r with
    | Empty => rfl
    | Tree rc rv rl rr => simp only [rotate_left, node_size]; omega

theorem size_rotate_right (t : Node) : node_size (rotate_right t) = node_size t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => rfl
    | Tree lc lv ll lr => simp only [rotate_right, node_size]; omega

theorem size_flip_colors (t : Node) : node_size (flip_colors t) = node_size t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => rfl
    | Tree lc lv ll lr =>
      cases r with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree rc rv rl rr => rfl

theorem size_rotate_right_right (t : Node) :
    node_size (rotate_right_right t) = node_size t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r => simp only [rotate_right_right, node_size, size_rotate_right]

theorem size_move_red_left (t : Node) : node_size (move_red_left t) = node_size t := by
  unfold move_red_left
  split_ifs
  · rw [size_flip_colors, size_rotate_left, size_rotate_right_right, size_flip_colors]
  · exact size_flip_colors t

theorem size_move_red_right (t : Node) : node_size (move_red_right t) = node_size t := by
  unfold move_red_right
  split_ifs
  · rw [size_flip_colors, size_rotate_right, size_flip_colors]
  · exact size_flip_colors t

theorem size_fixup (t : Node) : node_size (fixup t) = node_size t := by
  unfold fixup fixup1 fixup2 fixup3
  split_ifs <;>
    simp only [size_rotate_left, size_rotate_right, size_flip_colors]

theorem view_set_black (t : Node) : view (set_black t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c w l r => rfl
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) :
    delete_postcond t v (delete t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
